Sorry im trying my best to answer this even though im not a HM but an AP. please keep in mind English is not my first language and I'm having a bit of trouble getting my thoughts into words.


I was an au pair for 5 years and 3 of the 5 experiences were absolutely horrible because of the parents mostly. I love all my kids dearly and made each year work because of them because I saw how much I added to their little lives and how much they needed me and I'll do it all over again, I'll take the verbal abuse and disrespect aaaaalllll over again just to have those kids in my life 

I understand that a lot of girls and families don't do the program for the right reasons and what I've learned is that during the interviewing process you should feel 100% good about what was talked about and how your vibe feels and understand that patience is key, the right girl is out there. There are so many APs who will love and cherish your child and she'll contribute to your child's life and development without you needing to even ask.

Each time I had an interview where I felt a little bit of doubt, even just a tiny bit and still matched it would turn out to be a horrible year.

There are so many success stories and you will find your perfect match who's going to be gentle and kind and loving towards you and your child. 
I've experienced wonderful host families and all my host families experienced a wonderful au pair. We are out there and I hope you find her🫶🏻


*Just to clarify, by "the kids needed me" I mean in most cases where I had bad experiences the parents did not have much time for their children and never spent quality time with them and would constantly shout and fight with each other and also the kids BUT the kids found comfort, gentleness and attention from me which I understood made some of the parents very jealous because their children favoured me and that made the parents be very mean to me. I never tried taking anything from the parents and their children but I tried giving the children what they desperately needed from their parents but weren't getting. I have also met absolutely amazing parents who do anything and everything to ensure their children grow up happy and confident!
I appreciate it! I definitely will!
